title: STEW board
description: A blackboard: where task cards are posted and claimed, the bounds every run on it holds, the profiles it offers, the channels it hears and the ledger it appends to. spec/blackboard.md.

supports.description: The STEW versions this board's runtime reads, newest first.

bounds.description: The standing refusals every run on this board holds, enforced in code, whatever profile is worn.

at.description: Where the runtime enforces it: the request, the plan, the call.

profiles.description: The profile declarations this board offers, as paths relative to the board's root.

channels.description: Where requests come from, and what each may ask for.

cards.description: Whether a card can be answered on this channel.

accelerators.description: How many task harnesses may hold the model at once. 1 on a single-accelerator machine.

unanswered_card.description: Seconds after which an unanswered card is a No.

ledger.description: The append-only record file, relative to the board's root.
